title: Launch velocity contingency dashboard
body:
Sheet: Launch velocity contingency dashboard

Purpose: single-pane tracker combining roadmap milestones, week-by-week velocity, launch KPIs, automated risk flags, and immediate contingency actions. Designed to be used during final 6-week ramp and launch-week on-call.

Column headers (tab view): Week | Focus milestone | Owner | Planned points / tickets | Live throughput target (reqs/sec) | Current measured | KPI status (G/Y/R) | Risk score (0-10) | Trigger condition | Immediate contingency action | Escalation owner | Notes / comms

Sample rows:
2026-W09 | Beta external rollout | Priya Ramesh | 42 | 180 r/s | 162 r/s | YELLOW | 6 | throughput < target * 0.9 for 2 consecutive hours | Enable burst pool + throttle non-critical jobs; open incident channel #launch-readiness | Sana Patel | Rolling warm cache enabled at 09:10 PT
2026-W10 | Canary + model A trim | Marco Li | 18 | 80 r/s | 26 r/s | RED | 9 | error rate > 3% or latency p95 > 900ms | Roll back to model A v1.3; route 60% traffic to fallback region; initiate postmortem stub | Evan Clark | Model quantization experiment paused

KPI definitions (sheet section):
- Throughput (r/s): total successful inference responses per second measured at edge gateway.
- Latency p95 (ms): 95th percentile end-to-end.
- Error rate (%): 5xx + application-level failures per minute / total requests.
- Quality drift: evaluation score on control prompt set, run nightly.

Trigger thresholds (configurable cells):
- GREEN: throughput >= 95% target AND p95 <= 600ms AND error rate < 0.5%
- YELLOW: throughput 90%-95% OR p95 600-900ms OR error rate 0.5%-2%
- RED: throughput < 90% OR p95 > 900ms OR error rate > 2% OR quality drift > 4%

Risk score algorithm (text): weighted sum: 0.5*(1 - throughput_ratio) * 10 + 0.3*(latency_index) * 10 + 0.2*(error_index) * 10; color buckets map to >7 red, 4-7 yellow, <4 green. (This cell includes the formula example: =ROUND(0.5*(1-(current/target))*10 + 0.3*(MIN(1,current_p95/900))*10 + 0.2*(MIN(1,error_rate/0.02))*10,1))

Contingency playbook snippets (linked from row action cells):
- Burst-capacity: runbook id RBST-01 — steps to spin up reserved capacity, set autoscale multiplier, notify infra.
- Fallback model: repo tag and rollback script; warm model in standby zone for 15 minutes before reroute.
- Throttle non-critical paths: list of endpoints and circuit-breaker thresholds; client-side backpressure guide.
- Quality rollback: pin model to last known-good, start immediate eval on 200 sample prompts, notify product-quality.

Communication & gating matrix:
- Minor (YELLOW) events: owner updates #launch-readiness every 30m, ops pulls diagnostic logs, decide in 90 minutes whether to escalate.
- Major (RED) events: open Sev2 incident, page SRE rotation, notify execs via status page and #exec-launch, escalate to customer-support lead if customer-visible.

Decision gate checklist (tick-box column intent):
- All critical metrics in green for 48h? Y/N
- End-to-end smoke tests passing in prod lanes? Y/N
- Canary sample quality check >= baseline? Y/N
- Rollback window defined and validated? Y/N
- Communication owners assigned and confirmed? Y/N

Post-launch evaluation: 7-day window metrics to capture in sheet tabs: rolling unit cost per 1k tokens, error incidents by hour, top 10 slow endpoints, user-reported regressions, quality evaluation trend. Each item maps to an owner and a 3-week remediation sprint ticket.

Automation notes:
- This sheet uses two automation hooks: nightly batch job that populates current measured values (via Prometheus -> BigQuery -> sheet import) and a small Apps Script that computes risk_score and posts to Slack when new RED row appears. Config details and credentials stored in vault: linked_artifacts above.

Open items / questions:
- Confirm fallback-region capacity reservation policy for dedicated customers (action: Marco).
- Standardize time-window for throughput measurement across regions (action: Priya).
- Decide whether to auto-roll back on quality-drift > 6% or require manual approval (action: Sana).

How to use this doc in a run: 1) Owner fills planned points and targets at W-6. 2) Automated ingestion updates current values every 5 minutes during ramp. 3) On flag, owner executes cell-linked playbook and updates status cell to reflect action. 4) After launch, paste retrospective summary and link postmortem ticket.

Quick links at top (sheet cells): Slack channel: #launch-readiness | Incident runbook: RBST-01 | Postmortem template: confluence.redwood.com/display/PM/Launch+Postmortem

Footer: maintained by Product Ops. Last formal review scheduled: 2026-03-07.
